title: UK Gender Pay Gap Reports (Employers 250+, by Company Number) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current reports (default), or only the reports added or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to see each report as it is submitted and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

company_number.title: Company number
company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456 — every year the employer has reported.

reporting_year.title: Reporting year
reporting_year.description: The snapshot year: 2025 is the 2025/26 reporting year.

sic_codes.title: SIC code contains
sic_codes.description: E.g. 64191 — employers listing this SIC code.

submitted_late.title: Late reports only
submitted_late.description: Tick for reports submitted after the deadline.

median_hourly_pct_min.title: Median hourly gap at least (%)
median_hourly_pct_min.description: Reports whose median hourly pay gap is at least this percentage.

median_hourly_pct_max.title: Median hourly gap at most (%)
median_hourly_pct_max.description: Reports whose median hourly pay gap is at most this percentage.

mean_hourly_pct_min.title: Mean hourly gap at least (%)
mean_hourly_pct_min.description: Reports whose mean hourly pay gap is at least this percentage.

submitted_on_after.title: Submitted on or after
submitted_on_after.description: Only reports submitted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many reports (you are charged per result).
